ORDINANCE XIII OF 2001
SEHWAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XIII OF 2001
An Ordinance to amend the Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1994
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th
April, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS.1(13)/2001, dated
6-4-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Sehwan Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 4 of the Sindh Act No.V of 1994

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2001
SEHWAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XIII OF 2001
An Ordinance to amend the Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1994
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th
April, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS.1(13)/2001, dated
6-4-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 4 of the Sindh Act No.V of 1994.--In the
Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1994, in section 4--
(i) in subsection (1), for clause
(a), the following shall be substituted:--
"(a) The
Chairman to be appointed by Government."
(ii) . after subsection (1), the
following new subsection shall be inserted:--
"(1-A). The Chairman shall hold office for a period of
three years unless he resigns, or is removed earlier from his office. "
